accepted.why: make(map[string]string, len(dbAdminCarriedFields)+3) -> -3. A MAP size hint is not observable through cap() or any other API, and len(dbAdminCarriedFields)==4 so the mutant computes 1: positive, so no makemap panic either. Verified by hand: mutation applied, full suite still green. THIS ENTRY IS ALSO THE HARNESS CANARY (see canaries in ci_mutate.go) -- it MUST report LIVED. A run that reports it KILLED is not executing tests, and its score must be discarded.

strings.Index(lookahead, "remoteRef:") >= 0 -> > 0. Differs only when the match is at offset 0, which is unreachable: lookahead starts at the end of a regex whose terminal \S+ is maximal, so the byte at that offset is always whitespace or EOF. Probed empirically, including the adversarial `key: a/bremoteRef:` case where \S+ swallows the literal and Index returns -1; the smallest positive index observed was 1.

len(ms) > 0 -> >= 0 on a guard whose block's only side effects are inside `for _, m := range ms`. With ms empty the loop body never runs and the locals are built and discarded, so executing the block is observationally identical to skipping it.

sort.SliceStable comparator sortKey() < -> <=. Distinguishing them needs two entries with EQUAL sortKey() in one key's propFiles. Entries come from distinct esRef{key,prop,hasProp} map keys, so within one key they differ in (prop,hasProp); sortKey() is "" when !hasProp else prop, and esPropertyRx (`property:\s+(\S+)`) can never yield an empty prop. A collision is unconstructible, so with all-distinct keys the comparators are identical.

survivors() sort comparator, `<` -> `<=`. Distinguishing them needs two mutants sharing file:line:col:mutator, and gremlins never emits that -- verified across a real 6,639-mutant cmd/llz run, which contained ZERO duplicate keys -- so the comparator is never called on a tie. The sibling CONDITIONALS_NEGATION at the same site reverses the order and IS killed by TestSurvivorsAreSortedAndFilterAllButLived.

_not_in_this_file: TIMED OUT mutants are NOT survivors and do not belong here; they are unmeasured and
sit outside the efficacy denominator entirely. `llz ci mutate` fails the run on any
non-zero timeout count rather than letting them pass silently.
